evidence.quote: Now, careful planning is under way to remove that stimulus at the appropriate time.
Although I agree that hitting the zero bound presents challenges to monetary policy, I do not believe central banks should raise their inflation targets.
we need to be alert to the risk that households, businesses, and investors could begin to expect higher inflation based partly on an expanded central bank balance sheet.
we are developing new tools, including reverse repurchase agreements and term deposits that will allow us to drain significant quantities of reserves when necessary.
commitments to maintain interest rates at a given level must be properly conditioned on the evolution of the economy.
So far, longer-term inflation expectations have generally been well anchored over the past few years of unusual Federal Reserve actions.

parsed.rationale: Largely retrospective review of crisis tools, with a mild hawkish tilt from emphasizing exit preparation, conditionality of 'extended period' guidance, rejecting higher inflation targets, and vigilance over balance-sheet-driven inflation expectations. No explicit signal of imminent tightening, so net stance is near neutral.
